title: Ｗｅｂデザイン
subtitle: Web Design
educationalGoal: In this Web design course, students will learn the concepts behind website construction, including information structure and effective navigation, as part of efforts to impart the knowledge necessary for designing easy-to-read and easy-to-use Web pages. In addition, the characteristics of multimedia material, the use of HTML and CSS, as well as techniques for making Web pages using a laptop computer, will be covered.
advice:
Students are expected to acquire the knowledge and skills of webpage production based on the basic concepts of information design, understand the outline of the World Wide Web (WWW), and master fundamental website creation procedures such as planning, design, production, operation and management through practical training.

To accomplish this, students will gain an understanding of the basic grammar of HTML and practice the use of CSS as a basic writing method for expressing Web pages.

Students will also learn how to support various web browsers and web accessibility, and acquire the skills to offer  information on web pages.

activityGoals.body: Be able to browse the World Wide Web and search for information through it.
Be able to write Web pages using text and multimedia in HTML by using a text editor.
Be able to understand the basic steps of web pages to uploading files to a web server.
Be able to create a webpage layout using CSS.
Be able to create Web pages with expressions and information arrangements that suit the purpose.
Be able to understand the concepts of personal information, security, copyright regulations, and netiquette.
